crafting_systems.name: Alchemical Crafting
crafting_systems.npc: Cannith Melting Station (House Cannith Manufactury) makes the manufactured ingredients; Cannith Reforging Station (Artificer Workshops, Toven's Workshop) adds the material type and crafts every Legendary tier; Cannith Binding Station (Research Facility, Eldritch Site Prime) adds heroic Tiers 1-3; a second Melting and Reforging Station stand in Sharn - Cliffside Docks District, and the Melting Station is also a Guild Ship amenity
